content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-176. - Parking in space required.
content.summary:
Every vehicle parked in a timed or paid parking zone, a space governed by a pay station,
               or in a parking lot opened for the use of the public shall be parked entirely within
               one individual parking space as indicated by the traffic control markings.
(
